description.content:
Stripe webhook endpoint.

Minimal flow:
- Verify Stripe signature (if DOCFLOW_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set)
- On checkout.session.completed, issue a Parseflow API key
- Return 200 quickly

This is intentionally minimal for fastest launch.
